sources.note: Main Eyefinity website. Claims 7,000+ independent practices, #1 optometry software. Describes Encompass as integrated PM + EHR platform. SOC 2 Type 2 certified.
Encompass product page describing unified PM and EHR platform with scheduling, billing, patient engagement, and analytics.
EHR product page describing clinical documentation, exam templates, equipment integration, iPad app, patient portal.
Practice management product page describing scheduling, billing, claims, ERA, VSP integration, inventory management.
Legacy OfficeMate/ExamWRITER page. First-generation server-based software, predecessor to cloud-based Encompass.
ONC mandatory disclosures page. Could not fetch due to 403 error, but URL confirmed in CHPL metadata.
2013 press release announcing Eyefinity-ModMed partnership to integrate EMA with Eyefinity PM for optometry market.
2025 VSP Vision press release on Encompass rebrand. Unifies Eyefinity PM and EHR under one brand. Describes single login, expanded integrations, POS, multi-location management.
Eyes on Eyecare article on Encompass launch. Describes patient portal, exam protocols, image management, compliance tools, scheduling, VSP integration, analytics, auto-save.

Encompass 7.12 release notes. Very detailed: visit note unfinalizing, NCD warnings, OfficeFlow redesign, medication reconciliation, USCDI v3 CCDA, sensitive health info flagging, HTI-1 support, patient discharge status, inbound fax linking.

Encompass 7.9 release notes. Specialty contact lens parameters (SAG, Skirt, OAD, HVID), consolidated Rx views, over-refraction documentation, immunization tab redesign, MIPS credit improvements, new surgical and procedure plans.

Patient portal documentation. Patients can access: contact info, insurance, pharmacy, medications, allergies, medical/ocular/social/family history, problem list, implantable devices, appointments, CCDAs, PDFs, messages, lab results, Rx (glasses/contacts).
Software Advice profile for Eyefinity Encompass. Describes PM and EHR features, scheduling, billing, inventory, patient portal.

EMRSystems review. Describes ExamWRITER automated documentation, OfficeMate admin functions, 4/5 star rating. Notes billing efficiency, imaging integration. Criticisms: slow support, clunky mobile app, outdated patient portal.
ModMed ophthalmology EHR page. Cloud-based EHR for retina, glaucoma, surgical care. Confirms EMA is the underlying platform for Eyefinity EHR.
Wikipedia article on VSP Vision Care (parent company). Provides corporate context for Eyefinity as a subsidiary.
Eyefinity EHR iPad app listing. Confirms iPad-native design for clinical use.
Feature page for inventory management and lab orders with barcode scanning.
E-prescribing documentation confirming electronic medication prescribing capability.
